viewer_questions.text: What did the final joined-hands gesture seem to mean?
Did the opening feel purposeful or like waiting?
When during the clip did the flame first feel important to you?
viewer_questions.rationale: Without Q4, A-group and B-group flame-connection rates cannot be compared. Iris's 3-question set leaves this gap.

falsification_criteria.description: Panel A viewers report flame as first-noticed at higher rate than B viewers
falsification_criteria.falsified_if: Rate difference < 10 pp or not statistically separable

falsification_criteria.description: Both A and B viewers connect flame to final gesture at similar rates
falsification_criteria.interpretation: If true, opening hierarchy does not drive ending meaning — Iris's core assumption fails

falsification_criteria.description: B viewers report earlier flame importance (Q4) than A viewers
falsification_criteria.interpretation: Would mean figures-first makes flame feel premature, not subordinate
